attributes.title: Level 1

subgroups.name: solve 1

steps.hints: ❓ Did you use the draw wall tool to stop the Player sprite from moving through the purple tiles in the middle of the tilemap?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓Which tiles should act as walls on the tilemap? 

❓ How do you add walls to the tilemap?


Solution: 

Purple tiles in the middle of the white path tiles should be set as walls by using the draw walls tool.
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, the Player sprite is able to move right through the purple tiles in the middle of the tilemap! 


Fix the bugs in the code so that all of the purple tiles on the tilemap act as walls, stopping the Player sprite from moving through them.

subgroups.introduction:
Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!


Fix the bugs in the code so that the Player sprite can reach the coin, while avoiding the moving snakes!

validationItems.text: Purple tiles in column 3-6, row 4 changed to walls.
validationItems.failureText: Use the tilemap editor to set tiles to act as walls.

subgroups.name: solve 2

steps.hints: ❓ Did you change what row and column the sprites are placed on top of?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ How can you find the column and row coordinates of each tile on the tilemap?


Solution: 

The coordinates in the Player sprite’s [place sprite on top of] block are changed to (1,6) and the Goal sprite’s coordinates are changed to (8,1).
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, the Player and the Goal sprites are at the wrong positions! 


Fix the bugs in the code so that the Player sprite starts on the tile in the lower left corner of the tilemap, and the Goal sprite starts on the tile in the upper right corner of the tilemap.
